intent: Land one current-main-based, offline-only Sublimation Forge core repair: fail-closed no-op and proof-gated promotion semantics, a durable first-cause terminal kill marker registered with the memory write-policy sentinel, and immutable cumulative artifact lineage with exact local replay. Refresh only the DocOps surfaces required by the changed corpus. This packet does not activate a daemon, provider, campaign, container, service, remote host, promotion route, or participant flow.

honest_blockers: The historical source commit and packet IDs are archaeological evidence only: they do not authorize this work, prove current-main compatibility, or establish live service state.
The offline core cannot promote any candidate until a separate evaluator supplies strong-isolation proof for both ring 1 and every held-out workload.

The lineage manifest’s resolved_sha is a syntax-checked asserted locator, not an independently verified checkout attestation: this slice proves exact replay only for the declared evolve_file bytes. The sibling digest/pre-registration layer must bind the full target checkout and immutable execution-image identity before any promotion claim.
Artifact replay does not prove benchmark validity, external usefulness, upstream acceptance, or production readiness.

The offline campaign intentionally emits no promotion receipt. The sibling digest layer must bind the exact replay artifact, pre-registration state, and isolation proofs before any later receipt persistence.
The sibling immutable-image lane exclusively owns runner isolation, campaign-cycle, status, daemon, installer, unit, and nonstop-runbook surfaces and is intentionally outside this packet.
No Docker pull, live provider, deployment, service start, network campaign, VPS mutation, participant data access, or production probe is authorized.
interface_mismatches: The current offline loop treats any positive synthetic score as promotable and mints ring-2 receipts without an executed isolation proof; this packet makes confirmation fail closed while preserving exploration.
The historical terminal KILL writer used an exclusive file create but omitted its write from the reviewed memory write-policy baseline; this packet registers that exact operational-state write.

The historical cumulative artifact module depended on a live evaluator module; this packet separates strict patch replay into a bounded offline core module so artifact verification has no live-service dependency.

The historical offline campaign minted receipt-shaped identifiers without a verified digest binding; this packet removes that authority claim and leaves exact artifact-to-receipt binding to the sibling digest layer.

The canonical documentation registry does not currently name the existing Sublimation Forge runbook as an operator projection; this packet registers its authority boundary without editing the sibling-owned runbook.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the single packet-scoped implementation commit. Runtime state is not migrated or deleted; no service is started or changed, and historical packet/source references remain historical only.
